mapper.select: SELECT id, title, author, price, stock, sales, category, isbn, description, created_at, updated_at FROM book ORDER BY id
-- resultMap="BaseResultMap" SELECT id, title, author, price, stock, sales, category, isbn, description, created_at, updated_at FROM book WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (title, author, price, stock, sales, category, isbn, description) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{category}, #{isbn}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET title = #{title}, author = #{author}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, sales = #{sales}, category = #{category}, isbn = #{isbn}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
